en-US.title: POTENZO
en-US.subtitle: Train anywhere. Eat smart. Calisthenics and progress — simplified.
en-US.description:
Unlock Your Potential with Potenzo

Potenzo is your no-excuses fitness companion — designed for men who want to win every day. Whether you're training in a park or your apartment, Potenzo simplifies your path to progress with expert calisthenics routines, smart nutrition guidance, and a mindset-first approach.

This early version gives you a preview of what’s coming:
• A lightweight fitness system that adapts to your level
• Nutrition principles that work without obsession
• A gamified experience to keep you consistent
• Seamless integration with Apple Health and Google Fit (coming soon)

Right now, Potenzo is in early development. We’re building with intention, testing with real users, and evolving fast.

🚧 This is a beta version
What you see today is just the beginning. Follow our progress on Instagram @potenzo.app and be one of the first to shape the experience.

Potenzo exists because we believe people deserve to:
• Discover their true physical potential
• Connect their training with purpose and results
• Feel great — without wasting time or money

💪 No excuses. No fluff. Just progress.

Join us early and grow with us.
